A few weeks ago was my second time at HackWestern, and it was an amazing experience. Alongside Waleed Aamer and Ethan Groves, I build Echoes — an emotion-aware AI mental health companion that understands not just what you say, but how you say it. By analyzing voice tone in real time, Echoes can detect emotions like stress or sadness even when words sound neutral, and respond with empathetic, context-aware support.
